Question: What is the name of the college?
Answer: Greenfield Institute of Technology & Science (GITS) is an autonomous premier institution accredited with NAAC 'A+' grade.

Question: Where is the campus located?
Answer: The campus is located at 12 Knowledge Park Road, Anna Nagar East, Chennai, Tamil Nadu - 600102.

Question: When was the college established?
Answer: Greenfield Institute was established in 2005 and has over two decades of excellence in higher education and research.

Question: What are the office working hours?
Answer: The administrative and admissions office is open Monday to Friday (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM - 1:30 PM).

Question: How can I apply for admission?
Answer: You can apply online via the official Admissions Portal or submit a physical application at the campus Admissions Desk along with your marksheets and ID proof.

Question: When do admissions start?
Answer: Admissions for Undergraduate (UG) programs open in May and Postgraduate (PG) programs open in June each academic year.

Question: Is there an application fee?
Keywords: application fee; registration cost; form fee
Answer: The application fee is ₹500 for UG programs and ₹750 for PG programs, payable via UPI, Net Banking, or Demand Draft.

Question: Which documents are required for admission?
Answer: Required documents: 10th & 12th Marksheets, Transfer Certificate (TC), Conduct Certificate, Community Certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar ID, and 4 passport photos.

Question: What undergraduate courses are offered?
Keywords: ug courses; bachelor; btech; bsc; bcom; bba
Answer: We offer B.Tech (CSE, AI & Data Science, ECE, Mechanical), B.Sc (Computer Science, Mathematics), B.Com (General, Accounting & Finance), and BBA.

Question: What postgraduate courses are offered?
Keywords: pg courses; master; mba; mca; msc
Answer: We offer MBA (Finance, HR, Marketing, Business Analytics), MCA, M.Tech (Computer Science), and M.Sc (Data Science).

Question: What is the eligibility for B.Tech programs?
Answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (or equivalent) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with a minimum aggregate of 55% marks.

Question: What is the eligibility for MBA and MCA?
Answer: A recognized Bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate marks and a valid score in TANCET, MAT, CAT, or the College Entrance Test.

Question: What is the tuition fee structure?
Keywords: tuition fee; fee structure; semester cost
Answer: Annual tuition fees: B.Tech (₹1,10,000/yr), B.Sc Computer Science (₹70,000/yr), B.Com/BBA (₹60,000/yr), MBA/MCA (₹95,000/yr).

Question: Can fees be paid in installments?
Answer: Yes, students may pay tuition fees in two equal semester-wise installments with prior approval from the Accounts Office.

Question: Are merit scholarships available?
Keywords: scholarship; merit; fee waiver; financial aid
Answer: Yes! Students scoring above 90% in 10+2 qualify for up to 50% tuition fee waiver. Government SC/ST, BC/MBC, and First-Graduate scholarships are also supported.

Question: How are the placement records?
Answer: Our Training & Placement Cell achieves a 94% placement rate with top recruiters including TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Zoho, Accenture, and HCL. Highest package: ₹18 LPA; Average: ₹5.4 LPA.

Question: Are internships provided during the course?
Answer: Yes, mandatory industry internships are arranged in the pre-final year with stipends ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000/month.

Question: Are hostel facilities available?
Answer: Separate, secure on-campus hostels for boys and girls with Wi-Fi, 24/7 security, RO drinking water, study halls, and hygienic vegetarian/non-vegetarian dining. Hostel fee: ₹75,000/year.

Question: Does the college provide bus transport?
Answer: Yes, a fleet of 35 GPS-enabled college buses covers all major routes across Chennai and neighboring suburbs.

Question: What library and lab facilities exist?
Answer: Our 3-floor Digital Library houses 45,000+ volumes and IEEE/ACM journals. Campus features 18 high-speed AI/Computing labs, a sports complex, auditorium, and medical center.

Question: How are examinations conducted?
Answer: The college follows a Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) with two Continuous Internal Assessments (40%) and an End-Semester Exam (60%). Minimum 75% attendance is required.
